title: Tester acceptance equals instance value
statement: Let $D$ be a domain, let $V$ be a set of variables, and let a finite family of predicates on $D$ be specified, each with a finite arity. A tester chooses a predicate and an ordered tuple of distinct variables of the corresponding arity using a uniform draw from a finite nonempty seed set, and every variable in $V$ occurs in at least one selected tuple. For every assignment of values in $D$ to $V$, the tester’s acceptance probability equals the fraction of constraints satisfied in the associated instance, where the instance counts each seed’s constraint with its multiplicity.
hypotheses_covered: A finite family of predicates, each with finite arity
A finite nonempty seed set with a uniform draw
Each seed selects a predicate and an ordered tuple of distinct variables of its arity
Every variable occurs in a tuple selected by some seed
